name: Jupiter
source:
Yuno's fiancée. He is considered to be the next king because he is a man of sufficient capabilities, but he does not possess as much appeal as Yuno, the king's daughter. He thus remains in Thracia to protect her during the war expedition.

He is calm and mild-mannered, and has no malicious attitude toward Voldo. He is also a skilled swordsman, and no soldier can match his caliber of skill.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/ingoku/]official site[/url]]
